Subject: Post-discovery recap & next steps

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the conversation today — quick recap and two options for next steps so we can lock the right cadence.

Recap (TL;DR):
- Goal: reduce generation latency and monthly inference costs for your triage service while preserving accuracy.
- Primary constraints: SSO integration, on-prem model artifacts for PHI redaction, and 99th %-tile latency <= 250ms for 512 tokens.

Next-step options (pick one):
1) Ops workshop (60 min) — run through traffic profile, routing & caching recommendations; recommended when ops + infra are primary stakeholders.
2) Technical deep dive (90 min) — model architecture, quantization tradeoffs, KV cache behavior; recommended when platform + ML engineers are attending.

Please confirm:
- Preferred slot (we can do Wed 7/28 12:00 PT or Thu 7/29 09:00 PT) or propose two alternatives.
- Final attendee list (names + roles) and whether you'd prefer Google Meet or Zoom.
- Any required prework (SSO docs, firewall allowlist) — if so, send contacts.

I've attached a short mutual-action-plan (outline + prep) to help align agenda.

If you confirm a slot today I'll send the calendar invite with a Google Meet link by end of day.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
